sources.prompt:
Create an ORIGINAL standalone ENVIRONMENT PROP sprite sheet for the pastel forest-and-sea RPG shown in the reference. Fine softly shaded pixel art, ONE-native-pixel colored contours, no thick black ink, rich pastel woodland/sea color ramps, fixed elevated3/4 camera, no horizon. EXACT4COLUMNS x4ROWS on a SQUARE canvas, sixteen isolated props, target256x256native pixels per cell. Each full object centered with its base on the same baseline and wide transparent gutters, no object crossing cells.
Row-major subjects:1 moss-roof forest guide cottage;2 woodworker forge cottage with tiny mallet sign;3 herb garden greenhouse with leafy drying racks;4 orange-and-cream merchant awning stall with baskets;5 low circular stone fountain with a mint water jet;6 pearl shell-roof coastal guide cottage;7 shell blacksmith workshop with an ivory shell hammer sign;8 sea-herb pharmacy cottage with teal glass bottle sign;9 small moonleaf stone mentor shrine under silver branches;10 gigantic hollow ancient stump with ferns and shelf mushrooms;11 giant root-framed cyan crystal sea-cave entrance;12 little acorn wooden watchtower;13 low horizontal reed-and-wood footbridge with simple low rails (no tall back wall);14 wooden coastal pier with shell lanterns (no boats/anchors);15 tall salt-crystal arch with tiny silver vines;16 simple leafy wooden forest entrance arch. Maintain medium building proportions as game props, front doors visible, roots/stone foundations look grounded. No letters, readable text, NPCs, monsters, ground background, gridlines, shadows or white matte/halo. Fully transparent backdrop; all16 separate complete subjects.
